summary: Sweep correct, shared accounting helper, all 4 mutations red by name; only size-limit violations (822>620 total, storage test file 456>440), judged justified breadth.
notes: contract-check ok=false. Violation 1 (limits.max_diff_lines): diff of 822 lines exceeds limits.max_diff_lines=620. Violation 2 (limits.per_class): file crates/hexcell-storage/tests/barrido_de_reservas.rs (456 lines) exceeds per_class budget for glob crates/*/tests/**: max_diff_lines=440. not_checked: forbid.behaviors (checked by hand below). No touch/forbid file violation: the 6 changed files are exactly the touch list.

Size-overage judgement: NOT bloat. 36 of the 822 lines are the body of liberar_presupuesto moved into the private helper (counted as -36/+~50); the storage test file adds 3 cases beyond the spec's 4 (strict threshold boundary, single-transaction rollback via a RAISE(ABORT) trigger, ingesta reservation with NULL id_conversacion), each guarding a stated invariant. Mild duplication remains (the raw 'SELECT estado FROM reservas WHERE id' block is repeated 6 times; a 6-line helper would bring the file under 440), cosmetic only. The reviewer cannot waive the limits: the human gate must ratify the overage (contract amendment) or ask for the trim.
acceptance-coverage: pass, 12/12 AC covered, no gaps.

Mutation m3 (helper UPDATE saldo without disponible = disponible + ?1; diff 1/1): RED storage tests el_barrido_libera_una_reserva_activa_antigua_y_restaura_el_saldo (line 81, disponible==10), el_barrido_solo_toca_reservas_activas_antiguas, el_barrido_libera_reservas_de_ingesta_sin_conversacion; RED binary test el_arranque_libera_una_reserva_antigua_y_emite_el_evento_antes_de_servir; collateral RED in existing tests/presupuesto.rs: liberacion_devuelve_monto_completo_y_cierra_reserva and reservar_presupuesto_de_ingesta_permite_conciliar_y_liberar_sin_conversacion (proves the helper is genuinely shared with liberar_presupuesto).

Mutation m4 (sweep moved after servir_servicios_http): placement b, after the admin_vinculada emit -> RED el_arranque_libera_una_reserva_antigua_y_emite_el_evento_antes_de_servir at the order assertion (line 67). Placement a, immediately after the servir_servicios_http match but before the salud_vinculada emit -> all green: the guard is anchored on the salud_vinculada log line, not on the bind. Functionally harmless: servir_salud/servir_admin only bind the listeners and return a future whose accept loop is first polled in main's later select!, so no request can be served before the sweep in placement a either. Recorded as a known guard limit, not a defect; no stronger observable exists without a rusqlite dev-dependency (forbidden).

Behaviors checked by hand: liberar_presupuesto keeps its public signature (pub fn diff shows only the new pub struct ResumenDeBarridoDeReservas, the new pub fn liberar_reservas_huerfanas and the private fn liberar_una_reserva_activa) and its ReservaNoActiva re-SELECT; both callers use the private helper (state UPDATE, saldo UPDATE incl. actualizado_ms, SELECT disponible, movimientos INSERT clase 'liberacion' with progressive saldo_resultante). Sweep: one con_escritura + unchecked_transaction, SELECT by estado='activa' AND creada_ms < umbral (strict), ORDER BY creada_ms,id, commit once; Err drops the Transaction (rusqlite default rollback), proven by the trigger test (saldo 5/5, 3 movimientos, both reservas activa). umbral uses i64::try_from(as_millis).unwrap_or(i64::MAX) + saturating_sub, no panic path. No schema/migration/env change; configuracion.rs and apagado.rs untouched; antiguedad = configuracion.limite_de_drenaje; ahora = SystemTime::now().

main.rs: call sits at line 352, after GestorDePools::abrir (270), RepositorioDeSesiones::nuevo (298) and the initial-budget block (330-343), before receptor_apagado (378) and servir_servicios_http (412). Info event reservas_huerfanas_liberadas with 'recuento=N monto=M' when N>0, 'sin cambios' when N==0; Err arm: eprintln + NivelDeRegistro::Aviso with error text, no return/panic/unwrap, startup continues (AC-7 by reading; e2e not possible without rusqlite in crates/hexcell, accepted by design). Exactly one call; no periodic sweep.
